news.headline: Berkshire Hathaway boosts Alphabet to a top three holding, ups Delta and housing bets
news.summary: Berkshire Hathaway revealed it's doubling down on big tech: Alphabet is now a top-three holding worth $37.9B, cementing Google's parent as a cornerstone of Warren Buffett's portfolio alongside Apple and American Express.

news.headline: Cerebras stock plunges 14% after second earnings report following IPO
news.summary: Cerebras beat Q2 revenue expectations and upped full-year guidance, yet shares dropped 14%—a reminder that even solid earnings can't always overcome market sentiment or broader headwinds.

educational.title: How Venture Capital Actually Funds Startups
points: VCs invest other people's money (a "fund") in exchange for equity, not loans
Most funded startups fail — VC math relies on a few huge wins covering the rest
Funding rounds (seed, Series A, B...) mark stages of growth and rising valuation
Taking VC money means giving up some ownership and control in exchange for capital
Not every business should raise VC — it's built for high-growth, high-risk bets
